code:
A faster warehouse replacing the manual CSV:
  fixes Operations' freshness problem
  does NOTHING for Support's 2-minute requirement
  (not built for point lookups on a live stream)

Eventhouse for everything, including deep history:
  great for live lookups
  wrong tool for governed, long-retention trend data
caption: Each requirement genuinely needs a different engine.

code:
THIS DECISION DOES NOT REQUIRE:
- Replacing any scanner or GPS tracker hardware
- Any change to how drivers work day to day
- Downtime on the existing CSV export during the build
- A single risky cutover -- old and new run in parallel
